01

About

I focus on Python backend development and the infrastructure around it: designing REST APIs, modelling data, and getting services packaged, deployed and checked automatically.

Most of my projects are FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL. I use Pydantic for validation and settings, SQLAlchemy for data access with async drivers, and Alembic for schema migrations. I also work with MongoDB. On the infrastructure side I work in Linux environments, containerize services with Docker and Docker Compose, serve applications with Nginx, and automate checks and deployments with GitHub Actions. I have used AWS for data pipelines and for hosting a web server on EC2.

Backend

  • REST APIs with FastAPI, split into routers by domain
  • Async endpoints and database access with AsyncIO
  • Typed request and response schemas with Pydantic
  • Relational data modelling and migrations on PostgreSQL
  • JWT authentication, including refresh-token rotation

Infrastructure

  • One Dockerfile per service, multi-service Compose stacks
  • Separate migration step before the API starts
  • Nginx serving built frontends and static sites
  • CI with linting, type checks, tests and image builds
  • AWS: S3, Lambda, Glue, SageMaker, EC2

03

Projects

Personal and study projects. Source code is on GitHub.

  1. 01

    BudgetAnalytics

    Open source · v0.1.0, early release candidate

    Problem

    Tracking personal finances in Kazakhstan: accounts, transactions, budgets, savings goals and deposits in KZT, plus importing local bank statements.

    Approach

    A FastAPI backend computes every amount and analytic on the server, in the user's time zone. Statement imports (CSV/XLSX) go through preview → review → commit and are de-duplicated by row fingerprint. The services run in Docker Compose, with a migration service that runs before the API. CI checks linting, types, tests against PostgreSQL, migration round-trips, dependency audits and the Docker build.

    • Python
    • FastAPI
    • SQLAlchemy (async)
    • Pydantic
    • PostgreSQL
    • Alembic
    • Docker Compose
    • GitHub Actions
    Source ↗ BudgetAnalytics on GitHub
  2. 02

    MiniMessenger

    Open source

    Problem

    Real-time messaging between users: they register, find each other by username, open conversations and keep their message history.

    Approach

    REST routes in FastAPI handle auth, users, conversations and messages. A WebSocket endpoint per conversation delivers new messages live. Data lives in PostgreSQL through SQLModel, authentication uses JWT, and the backend and frontend are containerized with Docker Compose.

    • Python
    • FastAPI
    • WebSockets
    • SQLModel
    • PostgreSQL
    • Docker Compose
    Source ↗ MiniMessenger on GitHub
  3. 03

    GoalPyramids V2.0

    Open source · port of an iOS app

    Problem

    Bringing the GoalPyramid iOS app to the web: a goal pyramid, habits, projects, notes and analytics behind user accounts.

    Approach

    A versioned FastAPI API (/api/v1) with a service layer per domain and JWT auth. Getting the Compose stack to start meant fixing broken package imports, a passlib/bcrypt incompatibility and a database health check that never passed. It also meant setting up the Alembic migrations that the migration service runs.

    • Python
    • FastAPI
    • SQLAlchemy
    • Pydantic
    • PostgreSQL
    • Alembic
    • Docker Compose
    Source ↗ GoalPyramids V2.0 on GitHub
  4. 04

    MarketPlace

    Open source

    Problem

    The backend of an online store: catalogue, cart, checkout, order tracking and product reviews for authenticated users.

    Approach

    FastAPI routers for auth, users, categories, products, cart, orders and reviews. Checkout creates an order, and order status is updated through a separate endpoint. SQLModel with the async asyncpg driver on PostgreSQL, refresh tokens stored in the database, and the built frontend served by Nginx with a single-page-app fallback.

    • Python
    • FastAPI
    • SQLModel
    • PostgreSQL
    • Docker
    • Nginx
    Source ↗ MarketPlace on GitHub
  5. 05

    BookDB API

    Open source

    Problem

    A small, complete REST API for managing a book collection.

    Approach

    FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy against a managed Neon PostgreSQL database, with Pydantic schemas for validation. The backend and frontend are containerized with Docker Compose.
